prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the two silicone container from workbench.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether two silicone containers are on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Two translucent white plastic bottles stand upright side by side on a metal platform/rail. Each has a red angled-spout cap fitted in place. The left bottle carries a green band label around its middle; the right bottle has a blue band. Both appear to hold clear or colourless liquid, with a fill line visible roughly below the coloured bands.

Between and behind them is a grey extruded aluminium profile post; clipped to it is a small dark holder containing a narrow tube with an orange cap. At right, a metal instrument module with a spring-loaded shaft, black and white housing, and red connectors is mounted. A white sign at top left reads "...thesis Workstation"; dark framework is at upper left.
observations: The photograph shows two translucent white containers with red spout caps standing side by side on the workbench platform, matching the expected two silicone containers present before pickup.
